title: The Progress photos page checks every photo's file on the phone each time it opens, before showing any photo
what: Each time the Progress photos page comes into view, it first runs the after-a-fresh-install repair: it lists the phone's photo backup folder and then, one photo at a time, checks whether each photo's file is still there. Only after that does it read the photo list and draw it. For a member with backup on and a few hundred photos, every visit waits for a few hundred file checks that almost always find nothing to repair.
expected: The repair runs once after a fresh install or a restore, or runs after the photos are already on screen, so opening the page costs the same with 10 photos as with 500.
fix_line: Run the photo repair once after an install or restore, or after the list is shown

title: The phone screen never turns off while a workout is open, and there is no setting to let it sleep
what: While the live workout screen is open, the app keeps the phone screen switched on the whole time, even when the phone sits in a pocket or on the floor between sets. A 75-minute workout keeps the screen lit for 75 minutes. There is no choice in Settings to turn this off, so members who lock their phone between sets cannot.
expected: A Workout setting 'Keep screen on during a workout' (on by default is fine), so members who want to save battery can let the screen sleep; the rest timer already rings with the screen off.
fix_line: Add a Keep screen on switch to Workout settings and follow it
